text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. One important idea is responsive design, which means an app should work well on different screen sizes, from small phones to large tablets. Developers also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one system, like iOS or Android, and often perform better. Cross-platform apps work on both systems but may be slower. After development, apps are usually published on app stores, such as Google Play or the App Store. Finally, performance matters a lot, because users want apps that open quickly and run smoothly without crashing.
